claims: At 18 the rate is $19.74 and at 19 it is $22.56.
whys: The page's notices (line 92) say that from the first full pay period on or after 1 December 2026, 18 and 19-year-olds with more than 6 months' service must get at least the Retail Award's $20.86 / $23.64 (PR813655). The FAQ answer gives no condition, so it will understate pay for those staff from 1 December 2026. The FAQ needs a date-conditioned update, which a human should make because it needs new wording around figures.
reviewerNotes: The FAQ answer states 18 and 19-year-old rates of $19.74 and $22.56 with no condition. The page's own notice says that from 1 December 2026 the Retail Award floor ($20.86 / $23.64) applies to staff with more than 6 months' service. The FAQ goes stale on that date. This is not caused by the writer's edit.
